summary: A strict black-and-white long read in two chapters, 'The Story' (archival 1960s–70s titling-serif ads, specimens and book covers, each followed by the same text reset in GT Super) and 'The Design' (short paragraphs alternating with looping type animations). Every text block on the page is editable through one shared style bar, and the intro and outro paragraphs ramp through the weights clause by clause.
